senses.gloss: उप-पक्ष॑ अस्, m. the armpit
उप-पक्षौ (औ), m. du. the hair under the armpits, TBr.
उप-पक्ष—दघ्न॑ mfn. reaching to the armpit, ŚBr.
उपपक्ष्य᳙ mfn. being on the shoulder, AV. vii, 76, 2.
उप-पक्ष्म ind. (fr. -पक्ष्मन्), on the eyelash, Suśr.
उप-√ पत् P. -पतति, to fly near, hasten towards, RV.; BhP.
उपा-√ पत् P. (Impv. 2. du. -पततम् आ॑ … उ॑प, RV. v, 78, 1) to fly near to or upon.
उप-पात m. accident, occurrence, misfortune, KātyŚr.
उप-पात उप-पातिन्. See उप-√ पत्.
उप-पातिन् mfn. ifc. falling to, hastening towards.
उप-पात्र n. a subsidiary vessel, MWB. xiii, n. 1.
उप-पतनीय n. a smaller sin, minor offence, = उप-पातक, q.v., SāmavBr. i, 5, 14.
उप-पति॑ इस्, m. a paramour, gallant, VS. xxx, 9; Mn.; Yājñ.; Kathās.
उप-पत्ति f. happening, occurring, becoming visible, appearing, taking place, production, effecting, accomplishing, MBh.; BhP.; Bhag.; Ragh. &c.
proving right, resulting
cause, reason
origin, birth, Śiś.
ascertained or demonstrated conclusion, proof, evidence, argument, Sarvad.; Sāh.; Vedāntas.; Naiṣ.; Rājat. &c.
fitness, propriety, possibility, KātyŚr.; MBh. &c. (instr. उप-पत्त्या, suitably, in a fit manner)
association, connection, possession
religious abstraction, L.
use, employment, KātyŚr., Sch.
उप-पथ m. appendix [Aufrecht], BrahmaP.
उप-पथम् ind. on the way or road, Vop.
2. उप-पद् त्, f. the act of happening, occurring, taking place.
उप-पत्ति—परित्यक्त mfn. destitute of argument or proof, unproved, unreasonable, Rājat.
उप-पत्ति—मत् mfn. demonstrated, proved.
उप-पत्ति—युक्त mfn. id.

उप-पत्ति—सम m. (in log.) a kind of contradiction in which both the contradicting assertions are supposed to be demonstrable (e.g. sound is uneternal, because it is produced; it is eternal, because it is not tangible), Nyāyad.; Nyāyak.
उप-पन्न mfn. one who has approached a teacher (as a pupil), Suśr.; Vedāntas.
one who has approached for protection, R.
one who has obtained or reached, MBh.; R., Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 13
obtained, reached, gained
happened, fallen to one's share, produced, effected, existing, being near at hand, MBh.; Yājñ.; Ragh. &c.
endowed with, possessed of, furnished with, MBh.; Mn. &c.
fit, suited for the occasion, adequate, conformable, Śak.; Vikr.; Rājat. &c.
उप-पन्नार्थ mfn. having good reasons, MBh.
उप-पाद m. happening
effecting, accomplishing
See दुर्-उपपाद and यथोपपादम्.

उप-पद n. a word standing near or accompanying another to which it is subordinate (either a subordinate word in a compound [but not in a Bahu-vrīhi compound] generally forming the first member, or a discriminative appellation at the end of proper names, as वर्मन्, शर्मन् &c.; or a preposition, particle &c. prefixed to a verb or noun; or a secondary word of any kind which is governed by or limits the general idea contained in the principal word), Pāṇ.; VPrāt.; Sarvad.
(वृक्षाः कल्पो-पपदाः, ‘those trees which have the word कल्प as accompanying word’ = कल्प-वृक्षाः, Śiś. iii, 59; cf. Ragh. xvi, 40)
a bit, little, L.
उप-पादक mfn. causing to occur or happen, producing, effecting, making visible, Sāh.
उप-पादन mfn. id.
उप-पादन n. the act of causing to appear, effecting, doing, MBh.
bringing near, BhP.
giving, delivering, presenting
proving or establishing by argument, Sarvad.
explaining, examining, L.
उप-पादनीय mfn. to be treated medically, Car.
उप-पादित mfn. effected, accomplished, performed, done
given, delivered, presented
proved, demonstrated
treated medically, cured.
उप-पादिन् mfn. = ˚दक, Kathās.
1. उप-पादुक mfn. (for 2. See below) self-produced
उप-पादुक m. a superhuman being, a god, demon &c., L.
2. उप-पादुक (for 1. See above) mfn. having shoes, shod, W.
उप-पाद्य mfn. to be effected or done
to be shown or proved
being produced, coming into existence.
उप-पद—समास m. a compound containing an Upa-pada (e.g. कुम्भ-कार).
उप-परा-√ मृश् See उपोपपरा-√ मृश्.
उप-परा-√ सृ
उप-परासृ॑त्य ind.p. having crept near or towards, ŚBr. xiv, 1, 1, 9.

उप-परीक्ष् (उप-परि-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. to find out, learn, Lalit.;
to examine, inquire into.
उप-परीक्ष mfn. examining, Divyāv.
उप-परीक्षा f. id., Nir.
उप-परीक्षण n. inquiring into, investigation, examination, L.
उप-परे (उप-परा-√ इ) P. -प॑रैति, to go towards, go near, approach, ŚBr.
उप-पर्चन See उप-√ पृच्.
उप-प॑र्चन n. coition, impregnation, RV. vi, 28, 8; AV. ix, 4, 23
उप-प॑र्चन mfn. being in close contact, closely touching, Nir.
उप-पर्य्-आ-√ वृत् P. (pf. -आ॑-ववर्त) to turn round towards, ŚBr.; Kāṭh.
उप-पर्वन् n. the day before the Parvan or change of the moon, ŚāṅkhGṛ. vi, 1, 11.
उप-पर्शुका f. a false rib, N.
उप-पली (उप-पलि [for परि] -√ इ).
उप-पल्य्-अ॑य्य ind.p. turning back or round, ŚBr.
उप-पल्वलम् ind. on the pool, Naiṣ.
उप-√ 1. पा Caus. -पाययति, to give to drink, MānŚr. & MānGṛ.
उपाप m. the act of obtaining, acquirement. See दुर्-उपाप.
उप-पायन n. the act of giving to drink, ib.
giving to drink, watering, MānGṛ.

उप-पातक n. a secondary crime, minor offence (as killing kine, forgetting the Veda, breaking a vow of chastity, offending a Guru, selling the Soma plant &c.), Gaut. xxi, 11, &c.; Baudh. ii, 2, 12-14, &c.; Mn. xi, 66, &c.; Hariv. &c. (see also, Yājñ. ii, 210; iii, 225; 242).
उपपातकिन् mfn. one who has committed an Upa-pātaka or minor offence, Mn. xi, 107; 117.
उप-पाप n. a minor offence = उप-पातक, Yājñ. iii, 286.
उप-पार्श्व m. a shoulder
flank, MBh.
a lesser rib
the opposite side, L.
उप-पीडन n. the act of pressing down, oppressing
causing pain, tormenting, torture, Mn.
उप-पीडम् ind.p. (Pāṇ. iii, 4, 49) pressing, pressing on or to, Śiś. x, 47; Naiṣ.
उप-पीडित mfn. pressed down, oppressed
tortured, pained, distressed.
उप-पुर n. ‘near the city’, a suburb, L.
उप-पुरी f. the environs of a city, BhP. iv, 25, 26.
उपपौरिक mfn. being near or in the environs of a city, Daś.
उप-पौरिक See उप-पुर.

उप-पुराण n. a secondary or minor Purāṇa (eighteen are enumerated; the following is the list in the Kūrma-purāṇa: 1. Sānatkumāra, 2. Nārasiṃha (fr. Nṛsiṃha) 3. Bhāṃda, 4. Śiva-dharma, 5. Daurvāsasa, 6. Nāradīya, 7. Kāpila, 8. Vāmana, 9. Auśanasa, 10. Brahmāṇḍa, 11. Vāruṇa, 12. Kālikā-purāṇa, 13. Māheśvara, 14. Sāmba, 15. Saura, 16. Pārāśara, 17. Mārīca, 18. Bhārgava).
उप-पुष्पिका f. yawning, gaping, L.
उप-पूर्वरात्रम् ind. about the first part of the night, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 33 Comm.
उप-पूर्वाह्णम् ind. about fore-noon, ib.
2. उप-पृ॑च् mfn. (Nom. क्) adhering to, holding fast to (with gen.), RV. i, 32, 5.
उप-√ पॄ Ā. (Impv. 2. pl. -पृणध्वम्) to fill up, RV. vii, 16, 11.
उप-पौर्णमासम् and उप-पौर्णमासि, ind. (Pāṇ. v, 4, 110) at the time of full moon.
उप-पौर्णमासम् and उप-पौर्णमासि, ind. (Pāṇ. v, 4, 110) at the time of full moon.
उप-प्रक्षे॑ Ved. inf. of 1. उप-√ पृच् above.
उप-प्र-√ गा P. (impf. or aor. -प्रा॑गात्) to step near to, approach, RV. i, 162, 7; 163, 12; 13; AV. i, 28, 1; vi, 37, 1; VS. vi, 7.
उप-√ प्रछ् Ā. (1. pl. -पृच्छामहे) to ask (a person acc.) about anything, consult, MBh.
उपा-√ प्रछ् P. -पृच्छति, to take leave of R.
उप-प्र-√ जन् Ā. -जायते, to be born after or in addition to, Kāṭh.

उप-प्र-√ जिन्व् P. (Subj. 3. pl. -जिन्वन्) to please or gratify in approaching [Sāy.], RV. i, 71, 1;
to impel, stir up [BRD.]
उप-प्रति-√ ग्रह् P. to conciliate again, MaitrS.
उप-प्र-√ तॄ Caus. (Impv. 2. sg. -प्र॑-तारय) to convey or transport across, AV. ii, 36, 5.
उप-प्र-√ 1. दा P. to deliver over, present or give away to, ŚBr. i.
उप-प्रदान n. the act of giving away to
presenting, a present, VP.; Pañcat.; Kathās. &c.
उप-प्र-√ दृश् Caus. -दर्शयति, to point out to or towards Comm. on TUp. & Bādar.
उप-प्रदर्शन n. the act of pointing out, showing, indication Comm. on AitUp.
उप-प्र-√ भिद् P. (impf. -प्रा॑भिनत्) to crumble and scatter, TBr. i, 1, 3, 5.
उप-प्र॑भिन्न mfn. crumbled, TBr. i, 2, 13.
उप-प्र-√ भू P. (aor. 3. pl. -प्रा॑भूवन्) to be present for help, help, assist, ŚBr. xii, 4, 2, 10; 4, 2.
उप-प्र-√ भूष् P. (Subj. 3. pl. -भू॑षन्) to attend to, observe, RV. iii, 55, 1.
उप-प्र-√ यम् P. -यच्छति, to present in addition, ŚBr.

उप-प्र-√ या P. -याति, to go towards, approach;
to proceed towards, RV. i, 82, 6; TS. ii, 2, 1, 2; 3; ŚāṅkhBr.
उप-प्रा-√ या P. (Impv. 2. du. -यातम्) to come near, RV. vii, 70, 6.
उप-प्र-लोभन n. (√ लुभ्) the act of seducing, alluring, Daś.
उप-प्र-√ वद् P. (Impv. 2. sg. -प्र॑वद) to join in AV. iv, 15, 14.
उप-प्र-√ वृत् Caus. P. -वर्तयति, to throw or push down, TS.; Kāṭh.
उप-प्र-√ वृह् Ā. (Impv. 2. sg. -वर्हस्व) to tear out and bring near to one's self, ŚBr. iii, 9, 4, 22.
उप-प्र-√ श्रि P. to lay or lean against, Kāṭh.
उप-प्र-√ सद् P. (1. sg. -सीदामि) to enter (a house), inhabit, AV. iii, 12, 9.
उप-प्र-√ सृ Intens. Ā. (pf. 3. sg. -सर्स्रे॑) to move towards, reach, RV. ii, 35, 5.
उप-प्र-√ स्तृ Ā. -स्तृणीते, to lie down upon, RV. vi, 67, 2.
उप-प्र-√ हि P. (Impv. 2. pl. -हिणुत, AV. xviii, 4, 40; pf. 3. pl. -जिघ्युस् [Sāy. reads -जिग्युस्, but explains it by प्रेषितवन्तः] ŚBr. xi, 5, 1, 10) to send away to (acc.)
उप-प्राण m. a secondary vital air belonging to the body, W.
उप-प्राप् (उप-प्र-√ आप्).
उप-प्राप्त mfn. approached, come near, R.
उप-प्रु॑त् mfn. (fr. √ प्रु = √ प्लु, BRD.) flowing or rushing near, RV. ix, 71, 2
approaching [Sāy.]
उप-प्रेक्ष् (उप-प्र-√ ईक्ष्) P. (2. sg. प्रेक्षसि) to overlook, pass over unnoticed, disregard, MBh.
उप-प्रेक्षण n. the act of overlooking, looking at without interest, disregarding, MBh.

उप-प्रेष् (उप-प्र- √ 1. इष्) P. -प्रेष्यति (Impv. 2. du. -प्रेष्यतम्) to impel, AV. xviii, 2, 53;
to invite, summon (said of the Adhvaryu priest who summons the Hotṛ priest to sacrifice), AitBr. ii, 5, 6; 8.
उप-प्रैष m. invitation, summons (see the preceding), AitBr. ii, 5, 7; 8.
उप-प्ले (उप-प्ल-√ इ) for उप-प्रे, q.v.
उप-प्लव m. affliction, visitation, invasion, inundation
any public calamity, unlucky accident, misfortune, disturbance
a portent or natural phenomenon (as an eclipse &c.), MBh.; Suśr.; Vikr.; Kum.; Kathās. &c.
N. of Rāhu (who is supposed to cause eclipses), L.
N. of Śiva, L.
उपप्लविन् mfn. afflicted or visited by a calamity, Ragh.
under an eclipse, Kād.
flooded.
उप-प्लव्य mfn. to be overflowed
to be afflicted, L.
उप-प्लव्य n. N. of the capital of the Matsyas.; MBh.
उप-प्लुत mfn. overflowed
invaded, afflicted, visited
distressed, pained
marked by prodigies
swallowed (as sun and moon by Rāhu), eclipsed, R.; BhP.; Mn.; Ragh. &c.
उप-प्लुता f. (with योनि) a particular disease of the female organ, ŚārṅgS.; Car.
उपप्लुतेक्षण mfn. having overflowing eyes, weeping, Hariv.

उपाप् (उप- √ 1. आप्) P. -आप्नोति, to arrive at, reach, obtain, TS. vi; ŚBr.; AitBr.; AitĀr.; TUp. :
Desid. P. उपेप्सति, to endeavour to win over or conciliate, MaitrS. ii, 1, 11; Kauś.; Gobh. i, 9, 5.
उपाप्ति f. reaching
obtainment, ŚBr.; AitĀr.
